material_definitions: Lithium garnet oxides of the composition series Li(7-x)La3Zr(2-x)TaxO12 (x=0-2) were synthesized by the solid state reaction and characterized by the powder X-ray diffraction and the impedance spectroscopy.
Single cubic phases were obtained between x=0.2 and 2, while the end-member Li7La3Zr2O12 exhibited a tetragonal phase.

Lithium garnet oxides of the composition series Li(7-x)La3Zr(2-x)TaxO12 (x=0-2) were synthesized by the solid state reaction and characterized by the powder X-ray diffraction and the impedance spectroscopy.
Single cubic phases were obtained between x=0.2 and 2, while the end-member Li7La3Zr2O12 exhibited a tetragonal phase.

material_definitions: The LLZTx series is composed of Li(7-x)La3Zr(2-x)Ta(x)O12 solid solutions.
The powders were calcined at 900°C.
The composition Li6.7La3Zr1.7Ta0.3O12 (x=0.3) exhibits a cubic phase (space group Ia-3d).
The pellets were sintered to achieve relative densities above 91% with optimized sintering temperatures.

material_definitions: Lithium garnet oxides with formulas Li(7-x)La3Zr(2-x)TaxO12 (x = 0-2) were successfully synthesized by the solid state reaction method.
Single cubic phases were observed in the composition x range between 0.2 and 2.
The lattice parameters decreased with the addition of Ta.
Pellets with relative density above 91% were obtained from high temperature processing with sintering aids.
warnings: Temperature inferred as 25 Celsius (standard room temperature). This conductivity value refers to bulk conductivity.
